name: ai_marketing_skills_8bot_team
description: A comprehensive AI marketing staff capability combining 120 distinct marketing skills across 7 disciplines with 8 integrated auditor gates for performance and quality checks, deployable as a plugin, portable skill set, or 8-bot team on a single contract.

inputs.name: marketing_task_description
inputs.description: Description of the marketing task or campaign objectives to be addressed.

inputs.name: target_audience_data
inputs.description: Data representing the target audience profile for tailored marketing strategies.

inputs.name: discipline_selection
inputs.description: Marketing discipline to focus on (narrative, SEO/GEO, social, email, paid, influencer, launch).

inputs.name: performance_metrics
inputs.description: Metrics and KPIs to be monitored and optimized for marketing campaigns.

inputs.name: content_assets
inputs.description: Marketing content inputs such as text, media, ads, emails for processing or evaluation.

outputs.name: marketing_strategy_plan
outputs.description: A structured plan detailing tactics, messaging, channels, and scheduling tailored to the input task.

outputs.name: audit_reports
outputs.description: Outputs from 8 auditor gates (TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, STAR, RAMP) evaluating quality, effectiveness, and ROI.

outputs.name: generated_marketing_content
outputs.description: Campaign assets and copy generated or optimized by AI bots across selected disciplines.

outputs.name: performance_insights
outputs.description: Actionable insights and recommendations based on campaign audit and monitoring.

patterns: Modular AI bot team structure aligned to marketing disciplines
Multi-layer auditing gates for quality and ROI assessment
Skill portability enabling plugin or contract-based deployment
Integrated narrative and channel-specific content generation
Cross-disciplinary campaign orchestration and feedback loops
steps: Receive marketing task description and target audience data
Select relevant marketing discipline(s) for the campaign
Deploy AI bots specialized in selected disciplines to generate or optimize marketing content and strategy
Run audit gates (TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, STAR, RAMP) to evaluate outputs on multiple quality and performance dimensions
Aggregate audit reports to refine campaign strategy and content
Provide performance insights and recommendations for ongoing optimization
Finalize marketing strategy plan and deliver generated marketing assets
Optionally iterate with updated inputs or metrics for continuous improvement
use_cases: Launching multi-channel marketing campaigns with AI-generated content and strategy
Optimizing SEO and GEO targeting through AI-driven analysis and content placement
Conducting influencer marketing strategies integrated with automated auditing for impact
Email campaign automation with AI-crafted messaging and performance audits
Paid advertising campaign design, execution, and ROI analysis facilitated by AI tools
Narrative development and brand story crafting supported by AI across marketing channels
Portable AI marketing teams contracted for short or long-term marketing projects

prompt_templates.name: generate_marketing_strategy
prompt_templates.template: Create a detailed marketing strategy for the following objectives: {marketing_task_description} targeting {target_audience_data} focused on {discipline_selection}.

prompt_templates.name: audit_content_quality
prompt_templates.template: Evaluate the following marketing content using the TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, STAR, and RAMP gates: {content_assets}.

prompt_templates.name: optimize_campaign
prompt_templates.template: Based on these performance metrics {performance_metrics}, provide recommendations to improve our marketing campaign.

prompt_templates.name: generate_campaign_assets
prompt_templates.template: Produce marketing content suitable for {discipline_selection} discipline for the campaign: {marketing_task_description}.
